entries.name: handle
entries.description: A public name that belongs to one person until they release it, and is the address of a public page.

entries.name: home
entries.description: The things plugged-in is made of.

entries.name: link
entries.description: A title and web address on a public page.

entries.name: profile
entries.description: A claimed name's public page, with its links in the order they were put.

entries.name: handle.claim
entries.description: Claim a free name and make it the address of your public page, with its profile.

entries.name: handle.release
entries.description: Free your name and take its public page offline. Anyone may claim the name afterwards.

entries.name: handle.resolve
entries.description: Find the handle that holds a claimed name. A released or unclaimed name has none.

entries.name: link.add
entries.description: Append a link to your own public page. You need a claimed name first.

entries.name: link.order
entries.description: Move a link to a zero-based position. A position past the end puts it last.

entries.name: link.remove
entries.description: Remove a link from a public page.

entries.name: profile.get
entries.description: Read a claimed name's public page and its links in display order.
